tools.name: get_appraisal_methodology
tools.description: Explain how DomainValuator estimates a domain market value: the factors used (age, keywords, search volume, comparable sales, mozRank) and what an appraisal does and does not guarantee. Read-only.

tools.name: get_privacy_policy
tools.description: Return the DomainValuator privacy policy text from this page: what personal data is collected, how it is used, and how to contact support. Read-only.

tools.name: get_terms_of_service
tools.description: Return the DomainValuator terms of service from this page: conditions for using the free appraisal tool and related services. Read-only.

tools.name: list_domain_for_sale
tools.description: List a domain on the public marketplace. Available on every page, including /login after start_register or start_login. Sensitive: requires confirm=true. If the user is not signed in, returns login_required. Do not navigate away after auth — call this tool on the current page.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to list.

price.description: Asking price as a whole number in the chosen currency, e.g. 1250.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually create the public listing.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Go to another DomainValuator page: home, login, register, dashboard, privacy, or terms. Available on every page. After start_login or start_register, stay on this page and call list_domain_for_sale instead of navigating.

page.description: Destination page of the appraisal and listing journey.

tools.name: start_login
tools.description: Sign the user into their DomainValuator portfolio. Works on /login whether the login or register form is visible: this tool switches to the login form first, then signs in via fetch so this page stays loaded. After success, call list_domain_for_sale on this same page. Never echo the password back.

password.description: Account password. Used only to fill the form; never returned.

tools.name: start_register
tools.description: Create a DomainValuator account. Works on /login whether the login or register form is visible. After success the user is signed in on this same page so list_domain_for_sale can be called immediately. Never echo the password back.

email.description: New account email address, e.g. you@example.com.

password.description: Password, at least 6 characters. Never returned.

tools.name: valuate_domain
tools.description: Return a structured domain appraisal for one registered domain: estimated market value, TLD, creation date, mozRank, monthly search volume, extracted keywords, and whether the name contains digits or hyphens. This is an asynchronous check: a first call may return status "processing" with retry_after_seconds — wait that long and call again with the same domain. Do not wait inside one call. Read-only; does not list or sell the domain.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name including TLD. No protocol, path or www. Examples: example.nl, example.com.
